title: Jal Jeevan taps reach 38 kidney disease-hit villages in Andhra’s NTR district after Pawan Kalyan’s push
summary: With the intervention of Deputy CM Pawan Kalyan, purified Krishna water is supplied to the villages affected by renal ailments through a 130-km pipeline

title: The metamorphosis of policing in the capital city
summary: From tackling communal violence and left-wing extremism to confronting terrorism, cybercrime and narcotics, Hyderabad’s police force has evolved with the city. Over five decades, a single Commissionerate has grown into a sophisticated four-Commissionerate system backed by specialised units, advanced technology, intelligence networks and citizen-focused policing

title: RAKSHA: India’s 10-year blueprint for defence diplomacy and global strategic partnerships
summary: The strategic blueprint seeks to integrate defence diplomacy more closely with India’s wider foreign policy, economic interests and national security objectives

title: Language no bar: Inside Hyderabad’s multilingual cinema boom
summary: Subtitled releases, premium screens and smart promotions are drawing Hyderabad audiences to cinema from varied languages, beyond Telugu, Hindi and English

title: Telugus in uniform: A legacy of valour, service
summary: From the battlefields of 1971 and Kargil to Galwan and UN missions, generations of servicemen and women from A.P. and Telangana have upheld proud tradition of courage and sacrifice

title: T.N. man instigates schoolgirl to mix cow dung powder in free breakfast scheme sambar at Erode school, arrested
summary: Officials found that cow dung powder had been mixed only with a small quantity of sambar kept separately for a teacher to taste and that it had not been mixed with the sambar served to the students

title: From Nawabi shahar to a vibrant urban sprawl
summary: In five decades, Hyderabad has travelled a remarkable distance — from a laid-back capital with modest ambitions to a sprawling city of IT towers, Global Capability Centres and ambitious real estate projects. Various factors such as public investments, industrial and scientific institutions, migration, entrepreneurship and abundant land helped propel the city towards its present global profile

title: Indigo flight hits pole while parking at Srinagar airport, no injuries
summary: The Airport Authority of India said the details and circumstances leading to the incident will be examined by the appropriate authorities according to the prescribed procedures
